decisions.reason: After another year of learning, the lightly visible fifteen-day offer still appears redundant beside stronger express lines, so results likely fall below aspiration and management would reallocate resources.

The seventy-two-hour program remains a distinctive service proposition close to the core business, and a large firm in a growing market would usually keep it unless capacity strain or weak uptake clearly pushes it below aspiration.
As a dedicated express line with several models and its own page, it likely meets or approaches aspiration better than the other express offers and is worth retaining while variants are refined.

The digital ordering and service platform supports the firm's strategic move toward deeper advisory and service integration, so organisational slack makes continued commitment more likely than withdrawal.
The fire and smoke protection door fits the firm's compliance-led core portfolio and, absent evidence of clear underperformance, would normally be retained as a complementary safety product.
